draft: Nora, those are the two questions everyone asks first — where and how much — and they are exactly the right ones before you decide anything. From watching journeys like this one, the cost tends to follow what is actually changed underneath, not just the shape on top, so the same word can mean very different numbers for different people. If you were thinking about it for yourself, what would matter more to you — a subtle, natural refinement, or a more defined change you could really see?
